ns2:section.sectionText: Music 523, Jazz Oral History This class combines theoretical study and practicum in jazz oral history. Students will spend the first part of the course learning about oral history as a method of scholarly research, looking at samples of jazz oral history, evaluating jazz oral history projects, and establishing best practices for the creation of an oral history archive. The second part of the course will be dedicated to independent research. Students will, with instructor guidance, identify and contact jazz musicians in the Chicago area and conduct oral history interviews using UIUC equipment. Students will then follow established protocols for the archiving of oral histories.
